split: 24/24 by target fact family; one distinct source career per case; all cases fixed before any benchmark answer

limits: Curated checkpoints test information availability, not quality of autonomous note writing
Historical pending/resolved statements do not establish present status at every later step
Offline prefix decisions are not counterfactual promotion outcomes
No natural compaction forced or Jiuwen timing measured
No provider cache TTL inferred from cache-hit counters
Incomplete stale checkpoints differ from explicitly obsolete health/review values; analyze separately
Confirmation category mix can differ due to family-disjoint split
